sources.quote:
🔹 Keep base_url, just update model to deepseek-v4-pro or deepseek-v4-flash.
🔹 Supports OpenAI ChatCompletions & Anthropic APIs.
🔹 Both models support 1M context & dual modes (Thinking / Non-Thinking): <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/guides/thinking_mode>
sources.supports: DeepSeek announced the V4 API and models in April, but this announcement gives no prices or effective pricing date.

sources.quote: * The model names `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` will be deprecated in the future. For compatibility, they correspond to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode of `deepseek-v4-flash`, respectively.
sources.supports: The April 25 archived provider page says the legacy reasoner name corresponded to V4 Flash, but the extracted copy omits its pricing table.

sources.quote: Product prices may vary and DeepSeek reserves the right to adjust them. We recommend topping up based on your actual usage and regularly checking this page for the most recent pricing information.
sources.supports: The current provider pricing page does not establish historical cache pricing.

notes: The available provider materials establish that deepseek-reasoner mapped to V4 Flash by the April 25 snapshot, but do not expose a cache price for that earlier period or date a cache-price change. Attempts to extract a June 8 Internet Archive pricing snapshot failed because web.archive.org refused the connection, so the evidence does not decide whether 0.028 was an official earlier price or a models.dev error.
